description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressively applying work in batches, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. It is used to manage large or time-consuming tasks without blocking the UI, such as expanding tree nodes in a dashboard.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batch processing of items in a non-blocking manner, with start and cancel capabilities, progress reporting, and adaptive batch sizing.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller, providing UI state management (running, progress, counts) and methods to start processing from a list of items or cancel ongoing processing.
